title: You Did It!
paragraphs: In 7 Short Days, around your busy life and schedule, you took the Notes For Goats “do and learn” course, and equipped yourself with the knowledge necessary to run your own business adding to your own personal growth, having signed up with the proper establishments who pay you.

You also empowered yourself with the fundamentals of how to create and sell music and videos, then how to collect your royalties pay everyone, & take your earnings to invest in your financial and musical future.
You know when and how to get paid and who’s paying and how to instruct them to pay you your money directly.

The Legends of the Game would be proud of your commitment and envious of your access to this knowledge with the help of AI type technologies, which has been never been taught to the masses in such fullness of vision of the showing the entire process including the necessary forms and strategies to release your music seriously.
As an Alum, continue to use this as a resource to do great knowledgable business with your catalog and with your collaborators!
You are now a graduate of Notes For Goats!
